top_left.description: A soft, cream-colored beetle larva (grub) with a friendly face poking out of a burrow in the Pale lavender silt; surrounded by tiny Chalky white pebbles.

top_right.description: The beetle nibbling on a fallen, decaying Ginkgo leaf; it looks satisfied, with 'tasty' emoji-like expressions.

bottom_left.description: The beetle curled up in a cozy, silk-lined chamber beneath a Maroon mudstone rock; soft ambient blue light to indicate nighttime.

bottom_right.description: The beetle climbing over a 'giant' (to him) Limestone nodule, looking triumphant at the peak; high-angle shot to show scale.

visual_logic.lighting: DAPPLED_EXCAVATION with high-contrast shadows to emphasize the glossy shell.
